SAConnection.description: Configure once, reuse across nodes. For any relay, override the base URL and choose its API protocol.

base_url.name: Base Url
base_url.tooltip: Include the API version, e.g. https://host/v1. Leave blank for official presets.

api_key.name: Api Key
api_key.tooltip: Paste a key, env:VARIABLE or key:local_name. Raw pasted keys are saved in workflows.

protocol.name: Protocol
protocol.tooltip: auto follows the provider; relays can use any of these protocols.

SAText.description: Text in, text out. Supports OpenAI-compatible, Responses, Gemini and Claude APIs.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Model ID from your provider; any supported ID is allowed.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Write your request or connect a text output.

run_id.name: Run Id
run_id.tooltip: Change this value to request again with identical inputs.

SAImage.description: Generate images. Connect images to Preview Image or Save Image. Supports Images, Gemini, chat and Responses image APIs.

model.name: Model
model.tooltip: Model ID from your provider; any supported ID is allowed.

prompt.name: Prompt
prompt.tooltip: Write your request or connect a text output.

size.name: Size
size.tooltip: Images API: 1024x1024 etc. Gemini/chat: auto or aspect ratio, e.g. 16:9.

run_id.name: Run Id
run_id.tooltip: Change this value to request again with identical inputs.

SAImageEdit.description: Edit with one or many reference images. Connect up to four inputs or chain Image Set nodes for more. White mask areas are edited.

SAImages.description: Combine references without resizing. Chain image_set to collect more.

SAOptions.description: Optional settings. Connect only when needed. Extra JSON overrides defaults and merges nested objects.

endpoint.name: Endpoint
endpoint.tooltip: Optional endpoint override, relative to base URL.

extra_body.name: Extra Body
extra_body.tooltip: Provider-specific parameters, e.g. temperature, max_tokens, quality.

headers.name: Headers
headers.tooltip: Optional custom headers; env: and key: references supported.

image_api.name: Image Api
image_api.tooltip: Image nodes only. Gemini always uses its native API.

image_field.name: Image Field
image_field.tooltip: Multipart field expected by your relay.
